messages:
Maya: Quick UX probe — I'm sketching a per-model heatmap that shows how cache savings propagate across routes and what the marginal token cost looks like after credits. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/snap/heatmap-prop.png :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Maya: Goals: 1) let teams see which routes are getting most of the prefetch/prefix credit, 2) let product toggle between amortized vs marginal cost, 3) surface per-invocation delta when sticky routing or fallback to cheaper model happens. Thoughts?

TJ: Love it. Two quick concerns: sampling + attribution. If we only sample 1/10 requests we need confidence bounds on the heatmap cells. Also need metric names: prefer `invocation.marginal_cost_per_token` and `prefetch.credit_used` so signals line up with telemetry.

Oliver: Telemetry note — aggregation side: if we compute credits at ingest-time we explode cardinality (route x model x origin). Suggest computing per-invocation raw counters and rollups in analytics job. Example: ingest {route_id, model_sku, tokens, kv_credit} and rollup to heatmap daily.

Sasha: UX: add a toggle in top-right for "Include cache credits" vs "Show raw token spend". Also an option for a 7d/30d window and a little explainy tooltip: "Amortized = total credits / invocations; Marginal = how much this invocation altered billing after credits."

Kevin: SQL sketch for marginal cost (very rough):
```sql
SELECT
  route_id,
  model_sku,
  SUM(tokens * model_unit_price) / NULLIF(SUM(invocations),0) AS avg_raw_cost,
  SUM((tokens * model_unit_price) - kv_credit_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(invocations),0) AS avg_post_credit_cost
FROM invocation_events_sampled
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY route_id, model_sku;
```
This gives an amortized view per-route+model; marginal requires per-invocation diffs which we can approximate by marking when fallback/route-switch happened.

Maya: Nice. For sampling: can we attach a weight column and compute variance so UI can show confidence shading on heatmap cells? e.g., `sample_weight` and `effective_count`

TJ: Yes — keep sample_weight in the row and do weighted aggregations. For UI shading we can compute standard error and show thin/opaque cells. Also think about percentiles (p50/p95 token cost) because mean can be skewed by long tails.

Oliver: Implementation plan suggestion: 1) ingest raw rows with sample_weight, fallback_tag, kv_credit, model_sku 2) nightly batch rollup job writes heatmap tiles to a materialized table 3) console queries tiles for fast load + can fallback to live aggregation for ad-hoc ranges.

Sasha: Rollout UX: expose this under "Cost -> Experimental -> Cache propagation heatmap" first to org-admins. Add a small opt-in beta banner explaining sampling and known caveats. If we flip to GA, promote to top-level.

Maya: Agree. Can someone own the sampling stats and UI shading? I'm happy to spec the tooltip text.

Kevin: I can own the rollup job (ETL). Will wire the SQL and producers. Can we add an event flag `prefetch_origin` so we don't misattribute shared-prefetch caches?

TJ: +1 on `prefetch_origin`. Also add `route_affinity` tag to detect sticky routing effects. For cost math clarity, we should publish a small doc with formulas used by the UI (amortized vs marginal vs raw).

Maya: I'll draft the doc and the tooltip. Proposed timeline: spec + proto heatmap in console for internal beta in 2 weeks, public beta in 4 weeks. Depends on ETL slot.

Oliver: Heads-up: ETL backlog — push to triage but we might need to sample more aggressively to keep ingest costs down.

Kevin: I'll open a short-lived job with 1/20 sample for the beta and include `sample_weight` so estimates are unbiased. Job: INFR-2419.

deploy-bot: dashboard-service: rollout v2.3.7 to canary cluster for feature flag `cost_heatmap_beta` — 6% traffic.

Sasha: Nice, thanks. Once canary is healthy let's add a small callout in the console announcing the experimental flag so customers on Dedicated can enable it. :rocket:

Maya: Perfect. I'll post the proto mockups and tooltip copy in this thread tomorrow. Thanks everyone :heart:
file_comment: probe for new console cost heatmap that attributes cache savings and shows marginal vs amortized token cost
